$comment: Python app contract example. startup_command is REQUIRED for python (the classic deploy failure point). This example targets the ghr_timesheet_audit_app-style Dash app: gunicorn serving app:server. requirements.txt there has no database markers (no sqlalchemy/psycopg2/asyncpg), so kv_secrets is deliberately omitted — if you add a database dependency later, you must ask the operator to create the connection-string secret and declare it in kv_secrets or preflight will refuse to deploy.
